name: Apple iPhone 17
shortDescription: iPhone 17 with a 6.3-inch (15.93 cm) Super Retina XDR display up to 120 Hz, A19 chip, 48 MP Dual Fusion camera and 256 GB storage.
description:
The iPhone 17 has a 15.93 cm (6.3-inch) Super Retina XDR OLED display with ProMotion up to 120 Hz, an Always-On display and the Dynamic Island. It runs on the A19 chip with a 6-core CPU and 5-core GPU.

On the back is a 48 MP Dual Fusion camera system (48 MP Fusion Main and 48 MP Fusion Ultra Wide), and the front has an 18 MP Center Stage camera. Both record 4K Dolby Vision video at up to 60 fps.

It has an aluminium design with Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, is rated IP68, and supports 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, USB-C and MagSafe and Qi2 wireless charging up to 25 W. Apple quotes up to 30 hours of video playback. A USB-C charge cable is in the box; the power adapter is sold separately.
